Read by J.concentration_trait_bonuses (gen_jmath.lua:16, +1) and the two pain-threshold EOCs (gen_eoc.lua:8212, +15 pain).  port_traits.py only writes gen_granted_traits.json and only for traits reachable from NPC trait_groups / professions / CURATED_TRAITS -- none of these three are, so they live here by hand with no collision risk. description: The air around you is emitting a bright light.

transform.msg_transform: The air around you loses its radiance.

//: The 'on' half of the Photokinetic elixir light toggle.  Hand-ported from CDDA/data/mods/MindOverMatter/mutations/temporary.json:581-595 with upstream's `copy-from: PHOTOLIXIR_LIGHT` flattened by hand.  Lives here rather than in gen_granted_traits.json because port_traits.py only emits traits reachable from a GRANT site, and this one is reached only as a `transform` target.  LUMINATION is a real BN enchantment_value (enchantment_values.json:258-264, read at character.cpp:7364).  It MUST be `max`, not upstream's `add`: BN declares it `can_add: false, can_mult: false, can_max: true`, and `add` is a hard load error (`enchantment value LUMINATION cannot be added to`, enchantment.cpp:704) -- BN's own bionics use `max` too.  That is semantically right anyway, since character.cpp maxes lumination sources rather than summing them, so 150 is a floor.  Uses `mut_enchantments` (inline) not `enchantments` (by id); both exist in BN, mutation_data.cpp:463-480.

description: You are lashing out with your elixir-forged telekinetic powers.

transform.msg_transform: You rein your powers back in for now.

//: The 'on' half of the Telekinetic elixir surge toggle.  Hand-ported from CDDA/data/mods/MindOverMatter/mutations/temporary.json:469-481, `copy-from: TELELIXIRDOWN` flattened by hand.  Two upstream keys are deliberately NOT carried: `sleepiness: true` is DDA's rename of BN's `fatigue` (mutation_data.cpp:307) so it becomes `fatigue: true`, and `time: "1 m"` is a DDA duration string where BN wants an int of turns (mutation_data.cpp:303 -> `cooldown`, cf. BN's own WEB_WEAVER `time: 100`), so it becomes 60.  `activated_eocs: [EOC_TELELIXIR_CAST]` is dropped ON PURPOSE and nothing is lost: the port already runs that EOC from the global RECURRING table (gen_eoc.lua:607, every 2-5 turns) gated on `has_trait('TELELIXIRDOWN_active')` (gen_eoc.lua:21068).  The recurrence was always working -- the trait it waits for simply never existed, so the surge could never fire.

description: Your expanded mind is far more capable of understanding Netherum Mathematics than a mere human's.  You have a greater chance of awakening new psionic paths.
//: Hand-ported from CDDA/data/mods/MindOverMatter/mutations/path_mutations.json:1-13.  Lives here, not in gen_granted_traits.json, because port_traits.py only emits traits reachable from a GRANT site and nothing in MoM's JSON or Lua ever adds this one -- it is acquired through the ordinary mutation tree, so the def IS the grant path.  FORK CHANGE (2026-08-01, Discord idea): upstream offers this to the ALPHA tree only; here CEPHALOPOD and ELFA get it too.  The mechanism that actually matters is `category` -- BN derives the threshold requirement from the mutation's OWN category list at mutate_towards time (`for(cat : mdata.category) get_threshold_mutation_for_tier(cat, tierreq)`, mutation.cpp:1300-1306), looking up each category's own threshold mutation, so listing three categories means crossing ANY of the three thresholds qualifies.  `threshold_tier: 0` IS LOAD-BEARING -- WITHOUT IT THIS MUTATION CANNOT BE ACQUIRED AT ALL.  BN reinterpreted DDA's `threshreq` as a tier COUNT: a non-empty threshreq sets threshold_tier to 1 (mutation_data.cpp:344-351), then mutate_towards looks up `get_threshold_mutation_for_tier(cat, 1)`, which bails on `tier >= threshold_muts.size()` (mutation.cpp:113-126).  Every one of BN's 25 categories declares a SINGULAR `threshold_mut`, so that vector has size 1 and index 0 is the real threshold -- tier 1 is always out of range, returns NULL_ID, has_threshreq stays false, and `if(tierreq != 0 && !has_threshreq) return false` (mutation.cpp:1311) refuses the mutation forever.  No BN JSON sets threshold_tier anywhere, so nothing overrides the bad default; this appears to hit all ~114 vanilla BN mutations that declare threshreq, not just ours.  Pinning tier 0 makes the lookup resolve to each category's actual threshold AND skips the refusal branch.  Tradeoff to know: with tier 0 the must-have-crossed-a-threshold check is skipped entirely, so a pre-threshold character mutating down one of these three trees can pick this up early; the `category` list still keeps it inside those trees (post-threshold characters are locked to their own category by the threshold's `allowed_category`, is_category_allowed at mutation.cpp:443).  Early beats unobtainable.  The threshreq ids are kept because DDA *does* enforce them by id, so the def stays correct if it is ever ported back.  `prereqs` is an OR list (mutation.cpp:1248-1252 -- any one satisfies; `prereqs2` is a second OR list ANDed with it), so one entry per tree: INT_ALPHA for ALPHA, INT_UP_4 for CEPHALOPOD, INT_UP_3 for ELFA -- the smartest mutation each tree actually contains.  NOTE the id stays `MORE_PSI_ALPHA` and is now a misnomer: it is hardcoded in the awakening formula (gen_jmath.lua:104, generated from upstream jmath.json), so renaming it would silently sever the read and undo the whole feature.  All gates verified present in BN: INT_ALPHA (mutations.json:4185), INT_UP_4 / INT_UP_3, THRESH_ALPHA (:6129), THRESH_CEPHALOPOD (:6084), THRESH_ELFA (:6141), categories ALPHA/CEPHALOPOD/ELFA (mutation_category.json:161/124/226).  Read at gen_jmath.lua:104 (`matrix_awakening_odds`) and :120 (`portal_storm_awakening_odds`), where it subtracts 0.75 from the difficulty term before the exponential, raising the odds of awakening a new path.  ONLY the :104 read matters in BN: portal storms do not exist in Bright Nights at all, so the :120 formula and its caller EOCs are dead code and the matrix crystal is this fork's only in-world awakening route -- see the BN CONTENT GAPS section of HANDOFF.md.  That one live read is the justification for this def; until it existed the described bonus could never apply.  Upstream `vitamin_cost: 300` is deliberately dropped: BN's mutation loader has no such key (mutation_data.cpp reads only vitamin_rates / vitamins_absorb_multi), and MoM's vitamin resource is designed out of this port anyway.  `points` is mandatory in BN (mutation_data.cpp:290).  BN does not store threshreq as a requirement list the way DDA does -- it reads the key only to derive threshold_tier (mutation_data.cpp:345-348, mutation.h:85) -- but the ALPHA category gate still restricts who is offered it.  Upstream's "an greater chance" typo corrected.
